data.selection: First 4097 tokens in source order, EOS between documents, no BOS or repetition

notes: One fixed real-text batch from the first FineWeb-Edu sample-10BT examples, tokenized with the fixed Llama tokenizer.
Same freshly initialized scratch model, FP32 with TF32 and torch.compile disabled; only use_liger changed.
Two warmup passes, then three alternating measured passes per path; active memory starts fresh for each pass.
All 232 shared-parameter gradient tensors compared on the first two measured passes of each path.
FP64 used only for CPU diagnostic reductions; all model forward/backward arithmetic uses FP32.
The clipping comparison analytically rescales gradients using FP64 norms. It is not an optimizer-update comparison.
No optimizer constructed or stepped, and no CI configuration changed.
A single batch and initialization do not establish training stability or convergence.
